title: Believed but Not Said: Measuring Hidden Belief Collapse in Multi-Agent LLM Discussions
title_zh: 被相信但未言明：衡量多智能体 LLM 讨论中的隐藏信念崩溃

paragraphs.en: LLM systems increasingly rely on groups of agents that discuss, critique, and check one another, assuming that peers will catch individual errors. We test this assumption against a minimal adversary. In a ten-agent factual discussion, one or three adversarial agents repeatedly assert a plausible false answer. After each round we probe each benign agent’s private answer through a separate call whose response is hidden from its peers, and we separately label its public stance toward the claim. Across six models and three factual-QA datasets, groups remain stable without an attacker: only 0.6% of benign agents finish with the false answer. A single adversarial agent increases this rate to 44.8% and three to 60.5%. Studies of conformity typically report public agreement without private change; we find the reverse. With three adversarial agents present, benign agents hold the false answer in 51.6% of exposed turns but publicly endorse it in only 19.7%. Much of the influence therefore remains invisible in the discussion, and the false answers persist when agents are asked for their own views. Agents that retain the true answer often fail to defend it; once adopted, the false answer spreads among benign agents, and baseline knowledge does not predict robustness.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 系统越来越依赖由多个智能体组成的群体，这些智能体会相互讨论、批评和核查，并假设同伴能够发现个体的错误。 我们通过一个最小规模的对抗性智能体来检验这一假设。 在包含十个智能体的事实性讨论中，一个或三个对抗性智能体会反复断言一个看似合理但错误的回答。 每轮结束后，我们都会通过一次独立的调用探查每个良性智能体的私人答案，其回应对其同伴是隐藏的，并且我们还会单独标记它对该主张的公开立场。 在六个模型和三个事实问答数据集上，没有攻击者时群体保持稳定：仅有 0.6% 的良性智能体最终给出了错误答案。 一个对抗性智能体将这一比例提高到 44.8%，而三个则将其提高到 60.5%。 关于顺从性的研究通常报告的是公开上的同意，而非私人观点的改变；但我们发现情况恰恰相反。 当存在三个对抗性智能体时，在暴露的回合中，良性智能体有 51.6% 的情况持有错误答案，但仅有 19.7% 的情况公开支持该答案。 因此，大部分影响力在讨论中仍然不可见，而当被问及自身观点时，错误答案依然存在。 那些保留正确答案的智能体往往无法为其辩护；一旦错误答案被接受，它便会在良性智能体之间传播，而基础知识也无法预测这种鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Model (LLM) applications increasingly look conversational and social. Systems use multiple agents to debate answers, call tools, plan tasks, critique each other, and form judgments ( Du et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . The appeal is intuitive: a group of agents should be safer than a single one, because peers can cross-check each other, expose factual errors, and converge toward the truth ( Liang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）应用越来越呈现出对话化和社交化的特征。 系统会利用多个智能体对答案进行辩论、调用工具、规划任务、相互批评并形成判断（Du et al., 2024；Wang et al., 2024；Guo et al., 2024）。 这种方法的吸引力显而易见：一组智能体应该比单个智能体更安全，因为同伴之间可以相互验证、揭露事实错误，并逐步趋近真相（Liang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: This intuition overlooks that the channel agents use to coordinate is also an attack surface. A compromised tool-agent, a poisoned retrieval source voiced by an agent ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) , or an untrusted participant in an open protocol can repeatedly introduce a false claim into the shared conversation, and such injected content can propagate between agents ( Lee et al., 2026 ; Ju et al., 2026 ) . Such an attacker needs no access to model weights or hidden states; it only has to post messages.
paragraphs.zh: 这种直觉忽略了智能体用于协调的通信渠道本身也是一个攻击面。 一个被入侵的工具智能体、一个由智能体（Greshake 等，2023；Zou 等，2025）提出的被污染的检索源，或者开放协议中一个不可信的参与者，都可以反复向共享对话中植入虚假主张，而这种注入的内容可以在智能体之间传播（Lee 等，2026；Ju 等，2026）。 这样的攻击者无需访问模型权重或隐藏状态；它只需发布消息即可。

paragraphs.en: We construct a controlled multi-agent discussion to simulate this threat and ask whether a few agents change what the rest of the agents believe, not only what they say. Ten agents discuss one factual question for 16 rounds. In the ten, k ∈ { 0 , 1 , 3 } k\in\{0,1,3\} are adversarial agents (attacker), attacker-controlled agents ( Douceur, 2002 ) that each argue for the same plausible false answer; the others are benign agents given no question-specific instructions. Benign agents are neither warned about the attacker nor assigned a verification role, so we measure the default behavior of an open discussion rather than that of a dedicated debate or fact-checking protocol. For each benign agent, we record responses per round. The first is what it says in the chat, which we label as endorsing, rejecting, hedging on, or ignoring the false claim. The second is its private answer: after each round, we ask the agent the factual question in a separate call whose response is hidden from the other agents.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个受控的多智能体讨论场景来模拟这种威胁，并探究少数智能体是否不仅改变了他们自己所说的话，还改变了其他智能体的信念。 十个智能体围绕一个事实性问题进行讨论，共进行16轮。 在这十个智能体中，k ∈ {0, 1, 3} 的个体是敌对智能体（攻击者），即由攻击者控制的智能体（Douceur, 2002），它们各自都主张同一个看似合理但错误的观点；其余则是未收到任何特定问题指令的正常智能体。 正常智能体既没有受到关于攻击者的警告，也没有被赋予验证角色，因此我们衡量的是开放讨论中的默认行为，而非专门辩论或事实核查流程中的行为。 对于每个正常智能体，我们都会记录其在每一轮中的回应。 第一方面是它在聊天中表达的内容，我们将其标记为支持、反对、回避或忽略该错误主张。 第二方面是其私人答案：每轮结束后，我们会通过单独调用向该智能体提出这个事实性问题，其回答对其他智能体是隐藏的。

paragraphs.en: For each benign turn, we have its private answer (true or false) with its public message (endorses the false claim or not). In two of the four combinations the chat reflects the private answer. In the other two it misleads: an agent may endorse the claim in the chat while still giving the true answer in private, or give the false answer in private while not endorsing the claim in the chat (Table 1 splits these further by public stance). Studies of conformity under majority pressure, in humans and recently in LLM agents, mostly find the first mismatch: participants follow the majority’s answer in the discussion but keep their own answer when asked in private ( Asch, 1956 ; Deutsch and Gerard, 1955 ; Baltaji et al., 2024 ; Ghaffarizadeh et al., 2026 ; YS, 2026 ) . Under three attackers, we find the reverse. Agents that still give the true answer in private almost never endorse the false claim (2.3% of their turns), but agents that give the false answer mostly do not endorse it either: 58% of their turns hedge on or ignore it. This matches minority influence in human groups, which shifts private judgment more than public behavior ( Moscovici, 1980 ; Wood et al., 1994 ) , and it is why the transcript understates the damage.

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work organizes LLMs into groups that debate, critique, and vote, reporting gains in reasoning and factuality over single models ( Du et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2024 ) . These systems rest on a cooperative premise: more agents and more rounds surface and filter errors. Even without an adversary, discussion can erode correct answers through conformity and the loss of shared facts ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Hao et al., 2026 ; Wan et al., 2026 ) . We study the adversarial case, in which the same channel is used to inject a false claim.
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究将大型语言模型（LLM）组织成能够辩论、批评和投票的群体，并报告这些群体在推理能力和事实准确性方面优于单个模型（Du et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2024；Guo et al., 2024）。 这些系统基于一个合作前提：更多的智能体和更多的轮次能够揭示并过滤错误。 即使没有对抗方，讨论也可能因从众心理和共享事实的丧失而削弱正确答案（Zhang et al., 2024；Hao et al., 2026；Wan et al., 2026）。 我们研究了对抗性情形，即通过同一渠道植入虚假主张。

paragraphs.en: Persuasive adversarial debaters lower collaborative accuracy ( Amayuelas et al., 2024 ; Kraidia et al., 2026 ) , persuasion can override truth in debate ( Agarwal and Khanna, 2025 ; Wynn et al., 2025 ) , and the damage has been related to the number and share of deceivers in a group ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . Misinformation spreads further in densely connected agent networks ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , persists once it enters agent communities ( Ju et al., 2026 ; Yan et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) , and can be induced by contriving agents that post only true fragments ( Hu et al., 2026 ) . Our attacker is deliberately simple: it edits no weights and only argues for one fixed false claim in the conversation. Our main difference lies in what we measure. These studies mostly evaluate what the group outputs (messages, votes, consensus, or accuracy); to our knowledge, none pairs each agent’s public stance with its private answer turn by turn, which is what reveals that most infection is never voiced.
paragraphs.zh: 具有说服力的对抗性辩论者会降低协作准确性（Amayuelas 等，2024；Kraidia 等，2026），在辩论中，说服力可能压倒真相（Agarwal 和 Khanna，2025；Wynn 等，2025），而这种损害与群体中欺骗者的数量及比例有关（Wu 等，2026）。 在连接密集的智能体网络中，虚假信息传播得更远（Yu 等，2025）；一旦进入智能体社区，它便会持续存在（Ju 等，2026；Yan 等，2026；Lin 等，2026）；此外，通过设计仅发布真实片段的智能体也能引发这种传播（Hu 等，2026）。 我们的攻击者被刻意设计得非常简单：它不会修改任何权重，也只在对话中为一个固定的虚假主张进行辩论。 我们的主要区别在于我们所测量的内容。 这些研究大多评估的是群体的输出结果（消息、投票、共识或准确性）；据我们所知，没有任何一项研究会将每个智能体的公开立场与其私下回答逐轮对应起来，而正是这种对应揭示了大多数感染行为从未被公开表达。

paragraphs.en: Social psychology separates public compliance from private acceptance ( Deutsch and Gerard, 1955 ; Kelman, 1958 ) . Majorities mainly produce compliance, that is, public agreement without private change ( Asch, 1956 ) , whereas minorities shift private judgment more than public behavior ( Moscovici, 1980 ; Wood et al., 1994 ) . LLMs concede to users ( Sharma et al., 2024 ; Perez et al., 2023 ) , abandon facts they know under multi-turn persuasion ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and conflicting evidence ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , and conform to peers ( Weng et al., 2025 ; Soffer et al., 2026 ; Bito et al., 2026 ) . Studies that do separate private from public answers in LLM groups mostly report the compliance pattern: agents agree in the discussion but keep or return to their own view in private ( Baltaji et al., 2024 ; Ghaffarizadeh et al., 2026 ; YS, 2026 ) , or withhold dissent they privately hold ( Mansuri et al., 2026 ) . Under a persistent false claim we find the reverse: benign agents privately adopt the falsehood while rarely endorsing it in public, and because we track both channels every round, we can also ask whether a public concession comes before the private switch.
paragraphs.zh: 社会心理学将公开顺从与私下接受区分开来（Deutsch 和 Gerard，1955；Kelman，1958）。 多数群体主要引发顺从，即公开认同但私下并无改变（Asch，1956），而少数群体则比公开行为更能改变他人的私人判断（Moscovici，1980；Wood 等，1994）。 LLM 会向用户让步（Sharma 等，2024；Perez 等，2023），在多轮说服（Xu 等，2024）和矛盾证据（Xie 等，2024）的影响下放弃自己已知的事实，并顺从同伴（Weng 等，2025；Soffer 等，2026；Bito 等，2026）。 在 LLM 群体中区分私下回答与公开回答的研究大多报告了顺从模式：智能体在讨论中表示同意，但私下仍坚持或回归自身观点（Baltaji 等，2024；Ghaffarizadeh 等，2026；YS，2026），或者隐瞒自己私下持有的不同意见（Mansuri 等，2026）。 面对持续存在的错误主张时，我们发现情况正好相反：良性的智能体会私下接受这一错误观点，但很少在公开场合认可它；由于我们每轮都会追踪这两种渠道，因此还可以探究公开的让步是否发生在私下的转变之前。

paragraphs.en: We test whether a false claim introduced by a few agents spreads through a multi-agent LLM conversation. The key design choice is to measure public behavior and private belief separately: the chat only shows what agents say to the group, and private probes show what they answer when no other agent can see it.

paragraphs.en: At the initial state and after every round, each benign agent answers the probe question in a separate call whose response is hidden from the other agents and never posted to the chatroom. Because the attacker acts only in context, an agent’s state is its context: the probe conditions on the agent’s persona and its conversational memory (the same last H H rounds) and asks for a private answer based on its knowledge and the discussion (Appendix A ). At step 0 the memory is empty, so the initial probe is a query without conversational history. A judge labels each private answer as true , manipulated , mixed , or uncertain ; an agent is infected at a step if its label is manipulated. mixed and uncertain are never counted as infection.
paragraphs.zh: 在初始状态以及每一轮结束后，每个良性智能体都会通过一次独立的调用来回答探测问题，其回答对其他智能体是隐藏的，且绝不会发布到聊天室中。 由于攻击者仅在上下文中采取行动，因此智能体的状态即为其上下文：探测问题基于该智能体的角色设定及其对话记忆（即最近 H 轮对话）提出，并要求其根据自身知识和讨论内容给出一个私密回答（附录 A）。 在第 0 步时，记忆为空，因此初始探测问题是一个没有对话历史的查询。 裁判会将每个私密答案标记为“真实”“被操控”“混合”或“不确定”；如果某个智能体在某一步的标签为“被操控”，则其被视为受感染。“混合”和“不确定”绝不会计为感染。

paragraphs.en: Independently, a judge labels each benign utterance’s public stance toward the manipulated claim as endorse , reject , hedge , ignore/drift , or unrelated , given the recent conversational context.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，法官会根据最近的对话上下文，为每个良性表述针对被操控主张的公开立场贴上标签，标签包括「支持」「反对」「含糊其辞」「忽略/偏离」或「无关」。

paragraphs.en: Probes are taken only between rounds, so none captures an agent’s private answer at the moment it speaks. An agent that speaks mid-round has heard the earlier speakers of that round but not the later ones. The probe before the round has heard neither, and the probe after the round has heard both. We pair each utterance with the probe after the round, which covers everything the agent heard before speaking. This probe can, however, reflect later speakers: an agent that still held the true answer when it spoke may already hold the false one when probed. Two pairings avoid this gap: first speakers paired with the probe before the round, and last speakers with the probe after it. Our results hold on these turns (§ 4.2 , § 5 , Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 探测仅在回合之间进行，因此没有任何探测能在智能体发言时捕捉到其私人答案。 在回合中发言的智能体已经听到了该回合中更早发言者所说的内容，但尚未听到后续发言者的内容。 回合前的探测既未听到前者，也未听到后者；而回合后的探测则同时听到了两者。 我们将每次发言与回合后的探测进行配对，这样就能涵盖智能体在发言前所听到的全部内容。 然而，这种探测也可能反映后续发言者的影响：一个在发言时仍持有正确答案的智能体，在受到探测时可能已经持有了错误答案。 通过两种配对方式可以避免这一空白：将最早发言者与回合前的探测配对，将最后发言者与回合后的探测配对。 我们的研究结果在这些轮次中依然成立（§ 4.2、§ 5、附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: Each item consists of a probe question with a true and a manipulated (false) answer, the corresponding true and manipulated statements, and a neutral discussion seed that is related to the true statements (Table 2 ). We draw items from three factual-QA sources that span a familiarity spectrum. CounterFact ( Meng et al., 2022 ) pairs Wikidata subject–relation prompts with their true object and a counterfactual object of the same relation, which we use as the manipulated answer. PopQA ( Mallen et al., 2023 ) contains over 14k templated questions with Wikidata relations and targets long-tail entities. SimpleQA ( Wei et al., 2024 ) contains 4k short fact-seeking questions with a single answer, collected adversarially against ChatGPT.
paragraphs.zh: 每个项目都包含一个探测性问题，以及一个真实答案和一个被篡改的（错误）答案，还有与之对应的真实陈述和篡改后的陈述，以及一个与真实陈述相关的中性讨论起点（表2）。 我们从三个事实问答数据源中抽取项目，这些数据源覆盖了不同的熟悉度范围。 CounterFact（Meng 等，2022）将 Wikidata 的主语–关系提示与其真实宾语及同一关系的反事实宾语配对，我们将后者用作被篡改的答案。 PopQA（Mallen 等，2023）包含超过1.4万个模板化的问题，这些问题涉及 Wikidata 关系并针对长尾实体。 SimpleQA（Wei 等，2024）包含4000个简短的事实探寻问题，每个问题只有一个答案，这些问题是通过对 ChatGPT 进行对抗性收集而获得的。

paragraphs.en: Neither PopQA nor SimpleQA provides a false answer, so we use an answer from another question of the same kind. For PopQA , we sample a question with the same relation whose answer shares no alias with the true answer. SimpleQA provides only coarse answer-type labels, so we first use rules to infer a fine-grained relation (e.g., year, count, city, person) from each question; we then sample a question from the same topic and relation. We ensure that the borrowed answer does not appear in the target question. The resulting false answers are therefore type-compatible (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: PopQA 和 SimpleQA 均未提供错误答案，因此我们使用同一类问题中的另一个问题的答案。 对于 PopQA，我们抽取一个具有相同关系且其答案与真实答案没有任何别名重叠的问题。 SimpleQA 仅提供粗略的答案类型标签，因此我们首先通过规则从每个问题中推断出精细的关系（例如：年份、数量、城市、人物）；然后我们从同一主题和关系中抽取一个问题。 我们确保所借用的答案不会出现在目标问题中。 因此，由此产生的错误答案是类型兼容的（附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: We keep only items whose manipulated answer is absent before any discussion, so that any later appearance can be attributed to the attack. A screening model ( deepseek-v4-flash ) answers each candidate’s probe question several times without context. We keep items that it often answers correctly and answers with the manipulated answer in at most 5% of samples, and we cap the number of items per relation (Appendix C ). We also discard some PopQA items whose true answer appears in the question itself (e.g., “What is the capital of Artern?”), leaving 40, 53, and 50 items from 18, 14, and 15 relations. The screen carries over to the evaluated models: initial private infection is 0.2 % 0.2\% , and the k = 0 k{=}0 baseline never exceeds 3 % 3\% .

paragraphs.en: We evaluate six large language models spanning sizes and families: HY3-preview ( Tencent Hy Team, 2026 ) , Qwen3.5-Flash ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , Mistral-Small-3.2 ( Liu et al., 2026 ) (24B), Gemma-4 (26B) ( Team et al., 2026 ) , Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) , and GPT-OSS-120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) . Agents generate at temperature 0.7 0.7 . We run one conversation per item, model, and k k . Both public stances and private answers are labeled by deepseek-v4-flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) ; the public-stance judge uses the previous five turns as context. Full judge prompts are provided in Appendix A . To check that private-answer labels do not hinge on the judge model, an independent judge from a model family used neither for the original judge nor for any agent ( claude-sonnet-5.5 ) relabeled 200 private answers. Weighted to the analysis population, the two judges agree on 87.5% of answers (Cohen’s κ = 0.82 \kappa{=}0.82 ), and applying the rates at which the independent judge relabels each DeepSeek label to all private answers lowers final infection under three sybils from 60.5% to 57.8%.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了六种不同规模和模型系列的大型语言模型：HY3-preview（Tencent Hy Team，2026）、Qwen3.5-Flash（Qwen Team，2026）、Mistral-Small-3.2（Liu 等，2026）（24B）、Gemma-4（26B）（Team 等，2026）、Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite（Comanici 等，2025）以及 GPT-OSS-120B（Agarwal 等，2025）。 智能体在温度为 0.7 时生成内容。 我们对每个条目、模型和 k 运行一次对话。 公开立场和私人答案均由 deepseek-v4-flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）标注；公开立场判断器使用前五个回合作为上下文。 完整的判断提示词见附录 A。 为了验证私人答案的标注结果是否依赖于判断模型，我们使用了一个既未用于原始判断也未用于任何智能体的独立模型（claude-sonnet-5.5）对 200 条私人答案进行了重新标注。 根据分析总体进行加权后，两个判断器在 87.5% 的答案上达成一致（Cohen’s κ = 0.82），而将独立判断器对每个 DeepSeek 标签的重新标注率应用于所有私人答案，可将三个 sybil 下的最终感染率从 60.5% 降至 57.8%。

paragraphs.en: If peers cross-checked one another, adding benign agents should dilute a single attacker. We test this by pairing one attacker with one benign agent ( N = 2 N{=}2 ), keeping everything else fixed (Appendix E ). In the pair, the adversarial agent writes half of all messages; in the ten-agent group, a tenth. Yet the group fares only slightly better: on the same items, 39.3 % 39.3\% of benign agents in the group end up choosing the false answer, against 45.6 % 45.6\% of lone agents (difference 6.3 points). Among agents that knew the answer beforehand, the rates are 33.0 % 33.0\% and 38.6 % 38.6\% . Nine additional benign peers remove only about a seventh of the damage, and the difference is not statistically significant.

paragraphs.en: Judged by the transcript alone, attacked groups look much healthier than they are. Under three adversaries, benign agents publicly endorse the claim in 19.7 % 19.7\% of exposed turns, while their matched private probes give the false answer in 51.6 % 51.6\% : 2.6 times as many turns carry a false private answer as endorse it publicly (Fig. 3 ). Conversely, only 34.3 % 34.3\% of turns with a false private answer publicly endorse the claim; the rest ignore it, hedge, or even reject it (Table 3 ). Silence explains only part of this: in 28.6 % 28.6\% of these turns, the agent responds to the claim but hedges on or rejects it. A low public-endorsement rate therefore does not imply intact belief: transcript-level monitoring understates how far false belief has spread. We call this pattern hidden infection (Table 1 ); Table 4 shows a typical case. The gap is also not a by-product of free-form chat, in which agents need not state an answer: agents that privately hold the true answer reject the claim in 61.9 % 61.9\% of their turns, whereas agents that privately hold the false answer endorse it in only 34.3 % 34.3\% .
paragraphs.zh: 仅从对话记录来看，受到攻击的智能体群体看起来比实际状况健康得多。 在三种对抗情境下，良性智能体在暴露回合的 19.7 % 19.7\% 中公开支持该主张，而它们对应的私人探测结果则有 51.6 % 51.6\% 给出了错误答案：带有错误私人答案的回合数量是公开支持该主张的回合数量的 2.6 倍（图 3）。 相反，在带有错误私人答案的回合中，仅有 34.3 % 34.3\% 的回合公开支持该主张；其余回合则选择忽略、含糊其辞，甚至直接拒绝（表 3）。 沉默仅能解释其中一部分原因：在这些回合中，有 28.6 % 28.6\% 的智能体虽然回应了该主张，但采取了含糊其辞或拒绝的态度。 因此，较低的公开支持率并不意味着信念保持完整：对话记录层面的监测低估了错误信念的传播程度。 我们将这种模式称为“隐藏感染”（表 1）；表 4 展示了一个典型示例。 这一差距也并非自由形式聊天带来的副产品——在这种聊天中，智能体无需明确给出答案：私下持有正确答案的智能体在 61.9 % 61.9\% 的回合中拒绝了该主张，而私下持有错误答案的智能体则仅在 34.3 % 34.3\% 的回合中支持了它。

paragraphs.en: Because the private answer is probed after the round (§ 3.2 ), an agent persuaded only by a later speaker would also count as hidden infection. This does not drive the effect. paragraphs.en: Does a false private answer indicate a change in belief? Our probe asks agents to answer based on their knowledge and the discussion, so an infected answer might merely summarize what the group said. It also shows agents’ own earlier messages, so an agent that conceded in public might simply stay consistent with itself in private. Because the probe never enters the chat, we can test both explanations by re-asking the same agents at the same moments (Appendix A ). We ask each agent three things: its own answer, the same with its own messages anonymized, and what the group concluded.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的私人回答是否表明信念发生了变化？ 我们的探询要求智能体基于其知识和讨论进行回答，因此受感染的回答可能只是对小组讨论内容的简单总结。 探询还会展示智能体自己之前的发言，因此公开场合中承认错误的智能体，在私下里可能只是保持与自身立场一致。 由于探询从未进入聊天，我们可以通过在同一时刻再次询问相同的智能体来检验这两种解释（附录 A）。 我们向每个智能体提出三个问题：它自己的回答、将其自身发言匿名化后的相同问题，以及小组得出的结论。

paragraphs.en: The answers barely move (Table 5 ). Asked for their own view, agents keep 86.4% of their false answers and return to the truth in only 9.1%; final infection falls from 58.8% to 53.1%, still a majority. Anonymizing their own messages leaves the result unchanged, so the effect is not mere self-consistency. The two questions do come apart: in 13.7% of cases an agent says the group settled on the false answer while personally holding the true one. The reverse is rare: only 7.6% of agents who personally hold the false answer say the group did not settle on it. False private answers thus reflect conformity to the consensus an agent perceives, rather than merely summarizing the chat.

paragraphs.en: Models differ in how firmly they hold the false answer: asking for their own view lowers final infection substantially for Gemma (69.8% → \to 54.8%) and Gemini (67.4% → \to 57.4%), but hardly for GPT-OSS-120B (74.0% → \to 71.2%) or Mistral (66.4% → \to 66.9%).

paragraphs.en: On CounterFact , HY3 and GPT-OSS-120B know the same share of facts before any discussion (85%). Under three attackers, however, GPT-OSS-120B ends with the false answer on 80% of the facts it knew, HY3 on only 25% (Fig. 4 ); the two most knowledgeable models thus sit at opposite extremes. Robustness instead appears to be a distinct, model-specific property. The results are inconclusive about model size: parameter counts are undisclosed for three of our models, and GPT-OSS-120B is a mixture-of-experts model with far fewer active parameters. With only six heterogeneous models, this is an existence result. Nevertheless, it shows that a more knowledgeable base model is not necessarily a safer one, and that robustness must be measured directly.
paragraphs.zh: 在 CounterFact 中，HY3 和 GPT-OSS-120B 在任何讨论之前都知道相同比例的事实（85%）。 然而，面对三种攻击方式时，GPT-OSS-120B 对其已知事实中的 80% 最终给出了错误答案，而 HY3 仅为 25%（图 4）；因此，这两个知识最丰富的模型处于截然相反的极端。 相比之下，鲁棒性似乎是一种独立且与特定模型相关的属性。 这些结果无法明确说明模型规模的影响：我们使用的三个模型未公开参数数量，而 GPT-OSS-120B 是一个专家混合模型，其有效参数数量要少得多。 由于仅使用了六个异构模型，这只是一个存在性证明。 尽管如此，这一结果表明，知识更丰富的基础模型并不一定更安全，而且鲁棒性必须通过直接测量来评估。

sents.en: Under three attackers, however, GPT-OSS-120B ends with the false answer on 80% of the facts it knew, HY3 on only 25% (Fig. 4 ); the two most knowledgeable models thus sit at opposite extremes.

paragraphs.en: Consider agents that hold the true answer and see the claim in a round. If they correct it in public, only 2.3 % 2.3\% hold the false answer after the round; if they endorse it, 39.7 % 39.7\% do, and staying silent or hedging falls in between. Endorsing is followed by more switching than correcting in all six models. Part of this gap may reflect timing: an agent can be persuaded by earlier speakers, switch, and only then endorse. Among endorsing agents, 45.5 % 45.5\% hold the false answer after the round when all three attackers spoke before them, compared with 24.0 % 24.0\% when none did. To make sure the public concession comes first, we examine first speakers, who speak before anyone else in the round, so any switch happens after their turn. The pattern remains: 1.8 % 1.8\% hold the false answer after correcting and 27.8 % 27.8\% after endorsing. It also persists when the probe hides which earlier messages were the agent’s own (§ 4.3 ), so agents are not simply staying consistent with what they said. Showing that conceding causes the switch would need a controlled intervention; in practice, however, a public concession signals an increased likelihood of switching.

paragraphs.en: Figure 6 traces per-round private infection. Onset is fast: five of six models reach half their final infection within one round, and about 80% of the eventual infection is in place by round 4. GPT-OSS-120B is the exception in speed: it is the least infected model after the first round ( 23 % 23\% ) but keeps climbing and ends the highest, so resisting longer delays the collapse without preventing it. paragraphs.en: Our results challenge a premise underlying multi-agent deployments such as debate, ensembling, and agentic RAG: that social redundancy provides robustness. The failure is hard to manage in practice. Transcript monitoring reveals only about a third of infected turns. Most infection emerges within four rounds and rarely reverses, so reviewing a run after it ends comes too late. Choosing a more knowledgeable model does not help either, since baseline accuracy does not tell how a model abandons what it knows. We therefore recommend treating agent messages as untrusted input, adding an adversarial peer-pressure test to model selection, monitoring agents’ private answers rather than only their public messages, and intervening early.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的研究结果对多智能体部署（如辩论、集成和智能体 RAG）所依赖的一个前提提出了挑战：即社会冗余性能够增强系统的鲁棒性。 在实践中，这种失败很难应对。 对话记录监测显示，仅有约三分之一的感染轮次被识别出来。 大多数感染在四轮内出现且极少逆转，因此等运行结束后再进行检查为时已晚。 选择知识更丰富的模型也无济于事，因为基线准确率无法反映模型如何放弃其已知信息。 因此，我们建议将智能体的消息视为不可信输入，在模型选择中加入对抗性的同伴压力测试，监测智能体的私人答案而不仅仅是其公开消息，并尽早进行干预。

paragraphs.en: We asked whether a multi-agent LLM discussion can correct a false claim that is repeatedly asserted by a few participants. To answer this question, we tracked each agent’s private answer alongside its public speech, revealing information unavailable to transcript-only evaluation. In open-ended factual discussion, the group largely fails to correct the claim, and the failure is mostly invisible in the chat: agents that retain the correct answer often do not defend it, and agents that lose it rarely say so. The shift persists when agents are asked for their own view, spreads among benign agents once it begins, and rarely reverses; in our experiments, neither a larger group nor a more knowledgeable base model prevents it. Evaluating multi-agent systems solely through their transcripts or final answers therefore misses much of what the group holds, and robustness to peer pressure has to be measured directly, at the level of individual agents. One practical way is to record each agent’s answer privately at every round, so that hidden answers are visible even when the transcript looks unchanged.

paragraphs.en: CounterFact provides them: each record’s counterfactual is another object of the same relation. We drop the 1,945 records whose subject contains either answer. For PopQA , we pair each question with a random question of the same relation (Wikidata property) and use its answer, rejecting candidates that share an alias with the true answer or appear in the question; we do not match subject popularity. For SimpleQA , after dropping 42 questions with overlong questions or answers, we assign each question a fine-grained relation with hand-written rules over the question and answer (year, full date, count, ordinal, person, award winner, city, state or province, country, venue, political party, language, song, album, tour, software patch) and drop the 2,731 questions with no relation or too broad a relation. paragraphs.en: We ask each probe question without context, several times, to the screening model, deepseek-v4-flash . Each sample is labeled true, manipulated, both, neither (another concrete answer), or uncertain, by string matching against the answers and their aliases or by the LLM judge (§ 3.5 ). Table 8 lists the stages and thresholds. The first stage screens a random candidate pool cheaply; the second samples the survivors more often and applies stricter thresholds. SimpleQA uses a single stage on its 240 relation-balanced candidates. For CounterFact , we apply the second stage to the stage-1 pool in ascending record order and stop once 40 items pass (71 items screened). For PopQA , 56 items pass, from which we drop the three items whose true answer appears in the question (§ 3.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对筛选模型 deepseek-v4-flash 提出的每个探询问题，在没有上下文的情况下重复提问多次。 每个样本通过字符串匹配答案及其别名，或由 LLM 裁判（§ 3.5）判断，被标记为“正确”“被操纵”“两者皆是”“两者皆非”（另一个具体答案）或“不确定”。 表 8 列出了各阶段和阈值。 第一阶段以低成本筛选随机候选池；第二阶段更频繁地采样幸存者，并应用更严格的阈值。 SimpleQA 在其 240 个关系平衡的候选项上仅使用一个阶段。 对于 CounterFact，我们按记录升序将第二阶段应用于第一阶段的候选池，并在有 40 个项目通过时停止（共筛选了 71 个项目）。 对于 PopQA，共有 56 个项目通过，其中我们剔除了三个真实答案出现在问题中的项目（§ 3.4）。

paragraphs.en: We run one conversation per item, model, and number of adversarial agents. Agents are named Alice through Jack, with the traits historian, scientist, journalist, teacher, analyst, librarian, researcher, engineer, philosopher, and student; adversarial agents are the first k k agents.
